pc-anchor: empty scroll-target spans on the license panel (in-page anchors for #pc-license-panel/#pc-license-heading); mirror of shared license-anchor hook
pc-billing-action: JS hook on styled .button.secondary (time-entries billing-state filters; queried in js/time-entries.js)
pc-billing-filter-action: JS hook on styled .button.primary (time-entries billing filter submit; queried in js/time-entries.js)
pc-capacity-input: JS hook on styled .form-input (project-form available-hours); unavailable state rendered via styled .pc-capacity-input--unavailable modifier
pc-card: redundant marker emitted by synced config-transfer partial (transfer.php) on styled .pc-section; app-side emitters use the .section.pc-section recipe
pc-entry-billing-action: JS hook on styled .button.secondary (time-entry-detail settlement actions; queried in js/time-entry-detail.js)
pc-entry-settlement__actions: role=group marker on styled .actions-grid (settlement action cluster)
pc-entry-settlement__state: state row wrapper inside .section-content hosting styled .pc-settlement-chip
pc-export__label: label span inside styled .pc-export__toggle button (export menu)
pc-form-alert--error: tone variant marker on styled .pc-form-alert; the base rule already carries the error border/tint
pc-form-alert__body: body wrapper inside styled .pc-form-alert flex row; children .pc-form-alert__title/__text/__list styled
pc-get-app__features-block: section wrapper inside styled .pc-get-app-page; children .pc-get-app__features styled
pc-js-l10n-raw: hidden l10n data island read by js/pc-l10n.js via the #pc-js-l10n-raw id; never rendered
pc-member-rate-input: JS hook on styled .form-input (project-detail member rate editing; queried in js/project-detail-rates.js)
pc-pd-budget-meta: marker on styled .info-grid (project-detail budget & timeline facts)
pc-pd-span-full: layout marker on .projects-section; the single-column .content-grid already spans full width
pc-productivity__meter: role=img semantics wrapper for the meter aria-label; children .pc-productivity__meter-track/__meter-fill styled
pc-project-settle-btn: JS hook on styled .button (project-detail settlement actions; queried in js/project-detail.js)
pc-role-toggle-btn: JS hook on styled .action-btn inside #team-section .member-actions (queried in js/project-detail.js)
pc-section__primary-action-label: label span inside styled .button.secondary label-control (files-section upload trigger)
pc-settings: mount wrapper around the included parts/settings/* partial on the org settings page; inner sections carry their own chrome
pc-stl-progress--empty: state variant marker on styled .pc-stl-progress; empty note text styled via .pc-stl-progress__empty
pc-stl-progress__lead: sr-only region label paragraph on styled .pc-stl-progress (carries .pc-sr-only)
pc-table-actions: redundant marker next to styled .pc-license-table-actions (synced license-page pack row actions)
